sides.name: Russia and Austria (Alexander I, Kutuzov, Weyrother)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. 73,000 (Uffindell) to 89,000; Chandler 85,000, which Bowden calls theoretical strength. Mid 79,000. 278-318 guns. Role split is an educated guess. Command 0.3: Weyrother's plan stripped the Pratzen; Kutuzov overruled. Logistics/ISR low: Allies short of supply and deceived by Napoleon's feigned weakness.

sides.name: French Empire (Napoleon)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. About 67,000 on the field at dawn (Chandler) with 139-157 guns; ~7,000 of Davout's III Corps (Friant's division, Bourcier's dragoons) arrived after a forced march and entered the fight at Telnitz/Sokolnitz in the early morning (reinforcement at day 0.05). Role split is an educated guess. All categories at anchor 6 (1805, Gribeauval, Chappe semaphore). Command 1.0 = rubric anchor "Napoleon 1805".

outcome.note: French victory. Allies 27,000-36,000 (15,000-16,000 killed or wounded, 12,000-20,000 captured), 186 guns lost; mid is the midpoint. French 8,569-9,288 total incl. 573-760 captured; Roberts 8,279 killed and wounded only. Fighting about 08:00 to 16:30.
